logic.entry: Using a newly completed UTC first-half-hour, compute close(minute h+29)/open(minute h)-1; enter only if return > first_half_return_threshold AND first-half quote_volume / mean(first-half quote_volume at the same UTC hour over the previous 20 fully closed UTC days) >= same_slot_quote_volume_ratio_min.
logic.timing: Current first-half data is closed and available at h+30. Entry reference is h+31 one-minute open (60 seconds after signal availability). Exit is scheduled at h+61 open, 30 minutes after entry; no price from the traded interval influences its entry.
logic.exit: Sell full position at scheduled h+61 open. If rejected by frozen exchange filters, retry next one-minute opens until filled, with no missed entry retroactively inserted; ignore any next scheduled entry while inventory remains.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT long-only spot account per asset and parameter set; use currently available cash, no leverage/add-on/borrow/yield/transfers.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete UTC daily quote-volume ADV)
parameters.exchange_filters: Frozen Binance PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL, PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE; adverse tick, lot floor, previous closed 5-minute VWAP proxy.

sources.citation: Shen, D., Urquhart, A., & Wang, P. (2022). Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum. Financial Review, 57(2), 319–344. DOI:10.1111/fire.12290.
sources.reported_finding: The authors report that the first half-hour positively predicts the last half-hour return and that high-volume/high-volatility first sessions show stronger predictability. This BTC study motivates, but does not validate, our fixed UTC-hour BTC/ETH spot adaptation.

failure_gates.interpretation: Positive backtest results are historical screens only and do not establish future or live profitability.
